packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs (supply-chain hardening). Scoped to github-actions only — a global pinDigests caused Yarn Berry (npm) lockfile artifact-update failures: the deps/all PR (#759) regenerates yarn.lock with digest-pinned npm entries that `yarn install --immutable` then rejects (YN0028). npm packages already carry integrity hashes in yarn.lock, so digest pinning adds nothing but breakage there.

Freeze the build-stack boundary packages (Node, Yarn, Vue, Nuxt, and core build/lint/test tooling) — these are pinned intentionally and bumped only as part of a deliberate, coordinated upgrade, not routine automation.
Disable all major-version bumps — majors require manual review, not automated merging.
Group all remaining updates into a single PR.
